title: Hinomori Shiho — Head-On Rematch〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As I said yesterday, we won't be having practice today and will also be checking up on Saki throughout the day tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. We need her to rest as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I'm heading home to work on those lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we'll keep coming up with ideas!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Shiho, Honami.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, is it just the two of you?
I thought I heard that you'd all be coming over to practice today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
About that...
Some things happened and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Oh, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Ever the hard-working girl, I see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's not really a joking matter.
You should've seen how she looked...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honestly, it was impossible not to worry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you still let her do her thing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki isn't necessarily doing all this because she wants to become a professional musician.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After that time you said that we wouldn't be able to stay together if we tried to go pro, we had a long discussion concerning that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About whether or not we'd be able to commit to that goal and to our music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We each took a long look at ourselves, and we ultimately all decided to walk the same path as you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki too.
She decided that we're going to go pro together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki got worried and kinda pushed herself too hard that time, but ended up producing an amazing song after taking a really hard look at herself...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd be lying if I said that I wasn't worried...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'd rather show her some support by believing in her instead of hesitating or coddling her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, committing to somebody like that isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially since the more a person means to you, the more likely you are to feel concerned about them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You can believe in them as much as you want, but an equally great sense of concern can well up inside of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be honest, I did fret a little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And yes, I said that I'd believe in her, but I really wasn't expecting her to show up with those huge bags under her eyes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Haha...
That really was quite a sight.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was it that bad?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I seriously thought for a second she messed up her eye makeup or something and that's why she had really dark circles.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
I can see why you were concerned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika pulled an all-nighter this one time, but I didn't notice until Honami said something. So this time around...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I actually wasn't too sure, to be honest. I sort of just took a stab in the dark that time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's easy to tell when a person's tired, but I'd really rather not be surprised by someone looking completely exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. I think we all want Saki to live as healthy a life as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know. Why don't we get her a nice little treat once we're done coming up with ideas here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something she'd really appreciate and that's good for her health!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, something good for her health does sound nice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But they say good medicine's really bitter, so we might want to avoid something that tastes too nice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! Are you planning on getting revenge for her making you worry?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, not at all.
What makes you think that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Luka
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we set that aside for now and start coming up with ideas for that song?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can begin by cleaning up the rough draft Saki gave us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!
